Describes the real feature: grounded in the certified page text, plain-language, inside the creeds, denominationally neutral, 1 Peter 3:15 tone, with the pastoral/crisis path (lib/crisis.js) that stops and refers to real help. voiceover: Ever read a deep argument and hit a question you wish you could just ask someone? On Apologia Daily, you can. Every deep-dive essay and evidence card has an 'Ask AI Tutor' button. Ask anything, in plain English. What does that word mean? Isn't this circular? How would I say this to a friend? It's grounded in the certified text of the page you're reading — not random answers off the internet. Clear, short and patient — like a brilliant friend who knows philosophy and theology inside out, with everyday analogies for the hard parts. It stays inside historic Christian orthodoxy — the creeds — and won't take sides on the things Christians disagree on. Always with gentleness and respect. And if someone types something that shows they're hurting or in danger, it stops teaching, and gently points them to real help — a trusted person, a pastor, a crisis line. A patient tutor for the hardest questions of the faith. Free, on every essay and card.
